1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first component is a humeral surface component with a specific geometric configuration that is not disclosed in Rockwood et al.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a __humeral surface component__ and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature __that are independently selected and configured to provide a specific articulation geometry__.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is __elliptically shaped with a specific ratio of major to minor axes__.

13. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a smooth articulating surface __with a surface finish of less than 0.8 micrometers Ra__.

20. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem is __provided in a plurality of discrete lengths, each of which is selected prior to implantation, wherein said stem extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus__.

21. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper, and a screw __with a locking mechanism__.

27. (Currently Amended) __A glenohumeral joint implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint and providing__ a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and an implant.

28. (Currently Amended) The glenohumeral joint implant of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently Amended) __A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem, wherein said stem is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone__.
